name: cube-family

scripts.format: prettier --write scripts/visual-check.mjs src/game/siege/session.ts src/render/creature-view.ts src/ui/siege-panel.ts && node -e 'const fs=require("fs");for(const f of ["scripts/visual-check.mjs","src/game/siege/session.ts","src/render/creature-view.ts","src/ui/siege-panel.ts"])console.log("FMTJSON:"+JSON.stringify({path:f,content:fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8")}));' && prettier --check .
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run check:catalogues

description: An endless voxel world of light — explore, dig and build, in the browser, on desktop and on phones.
